summary: Frontend-only retest after radar sweep centering fix. Verified .radar-fx is centered in .map-stage (dx=0, dy=0, well under 15px threshold), border-radius 50% with radial-gradient mask applied. Inner .sweep2 and .sweep-line both exist with animation-name 'spin' and mix-blend-mode 'screen'. Real IDF SVG renders 8 department paths (75,77,78,91,92,93,94,95) with Paris.paris class and all number labels visible. Regression: floating pill navbar (CIBLES/MÉTHODE/SECTEUR/PROS/FAQ + header-phone + header-cta-devis), hero (hero-call/hero-whatsapp/hero-devis/hero-meta) all present, no .girophare. Contact form submission returned POST /api/contact 200 and form-message received 'ok' class.
